funds.directEquityBasis: ADIA's current infrastructure materials state that the Infrastructure Department takes minority stakes in infrastructure assets, either independently or alongside partners in full acquisitions; its Sempra Infrastructure case study documents a completed 10% non-controlling equity investment.

northAmericaQualification.rationale: ADIA's current Infrastructure portfolio identifies Sempra Infrastructure as a North American holding and attributes the completed 10% non-controlling stake to the Infrastructure Department; Sempra confirmed on 2026-07-09 that ADIA's existing 10% stake would remain while a separate majority-sale transaction was still pending.

snapshot.investmentStrategy: Evergreen direct infrastructure program making minority investments across transport, utilities, energy, and digital infrastructure, with a substantial renewables theme.

evidence.title: Infrastructure
evidence.evidenceLabel: Current Infrastructure Department mandate and portfolio
evidence.evidenceSummary: The current ADIA page identifies the Infrastructure Department, states that it takes minority stakes in infrastructure assets independently or alongside partners, describes its transport, utilities, energy and digital focus, and presents Sempra Infrastructure as a North American portfolio holding.

evidence.title: 2024 ADIA Review
evidence.evidenceSummary: ADIA's latest annual review describes the Infrastructure Department as actively deploying capital from a strong capital position, continuing to hold core strategic positions, and having finalised a 40% equity acquisition in digital and renewable infrastructure.

evidence.title: Sempra Infrastructure
evidence.evidenceSummary: ADIA states that a wholly owned subsidiary completed the acquisition of a 10% non-controlling stake in Sempra Infrastructure Partners in June 2022 and explicitly ties the investment to the Infrastructure Department's energy-transition focus.

evidence.title: Sempra Advances Strategic Priorities with Key Leadership Appointments
evidence.evidenceSummary: Sempra described Sempra Infrastructure as a North American infrastructure platform, said a separate KKR transaction remained pending for the third quarter of 2026, and confirmed that an ADIA affiliate's existing 10% stake would remain in place.

funds.repoDispositionRationale: The repository row matches the same sovereign infrastructure program, but current primary materials identify the official program as the Infrastructure Department rather than 'ADIA Direct Infrastructure'. The program has an evidenced current North American deployment through Sempra Infrastructure Partners, so North America is added to the existing Global region classification. The legacy ID is preserved and no other canonical repository field is changed.

notes: No separately named external fundraise or closed-end vehicle was disclosed; the only qualifying row is ADIA's sovereign Infrastructure Department program.
North American qualification rests on the program-attributed Sempra Infrastructure holding, with current ownership cross-checked against Sempra's 2026 disclosure.

Renewable-energy, listed-infrastructure, private-credit, secondary and fund exposures were reviewed as segments or access modes of the same department, not as separately capitalised commercial vehicles.
The repository's sole row is reconciled to FUND-003; the evidence supports corrections to fundName and regions.
Source-opening counts treat repeated opens of the same document as one source.
